long_biography.plain_text:
AmeriLife began in Holiday, Florida, as a storefront insurance agency serving people approaching retirement. Its early market was life and health cover for customers often overlooked by larger agencies. Under founder Gary R. Boesch, the business expanded across Florida, entered annuity brokerage and added national insurance-distribution contracts. By the mid-1990s, Boesch owned the Clearwater-based organisation that had grown from that local start.

A majority investment changed AmeriLife's ownership after Boesch had retired from the company. He remained active in business through Clearwater companies, serving as managing member of 21st Century Financial Services of Florida and manager of Capital Resources of Florida. Capital Resources manages several Florida property and investment entities.
